feature_set: original H9 F1..F9; no H9-v2, feature removal, recalibration or imputation

preprocessing.M0: raw original H9 to reproduce the unchanged baseline
preprocessing.other_four: StandardScaler mean and population SD fit on 12 training samples only; transform held-out without refit

tuning: none; one fixed setting per model; no validation-based model or parameter search
seed_interpretation: five paired computational repeats, not independent participants; deterministic models may repeat identical predictions
selection_rule: rank pooled mean Macro-F1, inspect both participant scores and P1 errors, then cost; propose at most two follow-up candidates, not validated winners

benchmark.unit: one already aggregated float64 H9 sample
benchmark.input_schedule: held-out 12 samples cycled in fixed source order
benchmark.order: rotate five models by seed plus fold; round-robin timed calls
benchmark.classifier_only: predict on preallocated transformed row; excludes scaling/aggregation/I/O/startup
benchmark.pipeline: scaler.transform plus predict on preallocated raw row, timed separately
benchmark.gc: disabled during measured loops; restored afterward
benchmark.model_size: len(pickle.dumps(model, protocol=5)); uncompressed; pipeline includes scaler; libraries excluded

overall_macro_f1: For each seed: mean six class F1s on pooled 24 OOF samples; then mean across five seeds.
distinct_participant_mean_macro_f1: Mean of two participant-specific Macro-F1 seed means; reported separately.
